title: GroundClasses
description: The land cover (biome) classes and the surface classes of narrow features (roads, paths, streams) stored in region masks, and the kind of ground each one is to drive on. Lives in defs/ground.json. Ids are what the mask files hold; never renumber, only append.

grounds.description: Kinds of ground a tyre can stand on; vehicle definitions give grip and rolling resistance for each.

softness.description: How far each kind of ground gives under a tyre, 0 firm to 1 a soft bog, when dry and when soaked by rain. Grounds left out are firm. For water it is the bed under it.

water.description: Water depth in metres: streams and pools on the surface layer, and how lakes deepen away from the shore.

lakeMax.description: Deepest a lake gets, far from its shore.

lakeShelf.description: Metres from the shore over which a lake reaches about two thirds of its greatest depth.

ice.description: How lake ice varies and what it bears. Its thickness through the year is in defs/seasons.json; near where a stream runs in or out, moving water keeps it thinner.

mouth.description: Share of the full thickness right where a stream meets the ice.

reach.description: Metres from a stream over which the ice thickens back towards full.

stream.description: Share of the full thickness on streams themselves.

strength.description: Weight in kilograms the ice bears per square centimetre of thickness squared: a vehicle of m kg needs sqrt(m / strength) cm.

ground.description: What this class is to drive on: one of `grounds`. A surface class without it leaves the land cover's ground in force.
